ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant central dark-intensity region radiating from the peduncle attachment point, surrounded by high-intensity lateral fields. Extensive transition zones characterized by dense, low-intensity stippling and mottling are visible between the solid dark and light regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with a narrow vertex and symmetrical separation of the primary lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular micro-serrations along the continuous trailing boundary, with significant structural jaggedness at the distal tips due to heavy epibiotic encrustation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trailing edge curve terminating in slightly upward-turned distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Massive, high-contrast clusters of circular/hexagonal calcified structures (acorn barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several discrete, vertically-oriented low-intensity linear streaks (potential rake marks) are visible on the high-intensity fields of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the fluke tips creating significant localized topographic anomalies.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly symmetrical distribution of dark pigment stippling concentrated along the inner trailing edges of both lobes.
